title: VIP Voice Consolidator: Weighted Request Bundling & Release Arbitration for Strategic Accounts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Overview: Build a lightweight orchestration layer ("VIP Voice Consolidator") that groups incoming feature asks from strategic accounts into weighted bundles, simulates release tradeoffs, and produces an arbitration recommendation with clear commit windows and fallback options. The goal is to reduce noisy 1:1 escalation pressure, shorten commit latency for top accounts, and make tradeoffs defensible to Sales/CS/Execs.
acceptance_criteria: Consolidator UI in Console that can accept and score requests from the existing intake form (score parameters: revenue weight, renewal proximity, severity, implementation effort) - prototype behind feature flag
Simulator produces 3 deterministic release proposals given current backlog & capacity (aggressive, balanced, conservative) and shows delta in expected delivery windows
Arbitration export (PDF/Drive link) summarizing rationale + fallback plan and a machine-readable summary posted to customer ticketing system (or Hub) via webhook
SLA for top-account escalations introduced: acknowledge within 24h, arbitration recommendation within 10 business days for grouped asks
Instrument telemetry: time-to-ack, time-to-arbitration, % of arbitration proposals accepted by Sales/CS
success_metrics: Reduce one-off escalations per top account by 40% in Q2
Median time-to-commit for grouped VIP asks <= 21 days
Increase Sales/CS acceptance rate of automation proposals to >= 65%
No-regression on platform throughput or console latency (< 5% increase)
Churn-risk reduction signal: top-account churn-risk delta <= -10% over 90 days after adoption
timeline: Week 1-2: Design & intake schema extension; decide scoring weights with Sales/CS
Week 3-4: Implement simulation engine (capacity model + backlog snapshot) and wire up scoring
Week 5: Internal dogfood with two pilot accounts; collect feedback
Week 6: Console UI + arbitration export + webhooks; roll behind feature flag
Week 7-8: Pilot validation, metrics instrumentation; prepare rollout playbook
Week 9: Gradual enable for top-50 accounts; measure and iterate
open_questions: Should scoring weights be editable per-account or global with account multipliers?
What's the canonical source for implementation-effort estimates (ENG T-shirt size vs. historical cycle data)?
Do we need a legal-approved template for arbitration exports at GA?
How do we reconcile with existing fast-track lanes (if a request is both fast-track and part of a bundle)?
risks_mitigations: Risk: Sales/CS reject automated recommendations - Mitigation: include human approval step and transparent rationale in export
Risk: Simulator deviates from real delivery windows - Mitigation: conservative capacity model initially and clear confidence scores
Risk: Added console complexity - Mitigation: progressive disclosure UI and detailed helptext authored by DX team
notes: Prototype will reuse intake form backend (no DB migration in Phase 1); store bundle metadata as tags to simplify rollback
We should align scoring weights with Renewal Risk model maintained by CS; schedule sync with Lara Becker week 1
Coordinate with Eng infra for webhook throughput and retries (Mateo)
